description:
One weekend a year a large mausoleum opens to the public, it is a huge place with many floors, rooms, and corridors. People are free to wander around and look at all of the names and dates of people who are spending their death there. It is an old building that is getting shabby and run down, but it is a beautiful and fascinating place nonetheless. Microphones: Sennheiser MKH 8020 in SASS
Recorder: Zaxcom Maaxx
Recordist: Tim Kahn
